candidate.answerReason: Adjacent sides of a rectangle are perpendicular, so the diagonal satisfies d²=12²+5²=169. Its positive length is 13 cm.

methods.label: Use the diagonal as a right-triangle hypotenuse
methods.explanation: The diagonal is the hypotenuse of a right triangle whose legs are the length and width: \(\sqrt{12^2+5^2}=13\).
methods.levelReason: The calculation uses the Grade 8 Pythagorean theorem and previously learned rectangle properties.
